name: Busa PR Review
description: GitHub pull request review desk backed by the gh CLI

agentPrompts.label: Refresh the review queue from GitHub
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-pr-review` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then run `generate_review_batch.mjs --apply` to gather my open PRs with `gh` and refresh the review queue, and give me the AirApp URL to review it.

agentPrompts.label: Submit my approved reviews to GitHub
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-pr-review` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then run `execute_decisions.mjs --apply` to re-read approved items and submit the real `gh pr review` call for each — never merge, close, push, or touch anything not marked approved.

agentPrompts.label: How is the review queue looking?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-pr-review` skill in this folder, then give me a status overview of the review queue — counts for needs_review, to_approve, approved, done, and blocked.
